ATTRIBUTION. Retro R2's PercentSizeClamp (runtimes/compose/…/sizing/PercentSizeClamp.kt) routes a percent axis carrying a min/max through one Modifier.layout {} block; Compose answers an INTRINSIC query for such a block with the child's raw intrinsic (the minHeight the block passes is ignored by DefaultIntrinsicMeasurable), so TableApplier's heightAtMinIntrinsic row query saw 0 for the content-less `overflow-y:auto; height:100%; min-height:100px` cell child where the pre-R2 heightIn(min=100) SizeNode answered 100. Fix (commit 962effa5): the min/max SizeNode is chained INSIDE the clamp on both axes — inert at measure time, the floor at intrinsic time. Pin SizingMinMaxClampTest §5, proven able to fail by mutation.
